column1: # Shared rule test vectors for Portmaster on Android.
# Read by the engine (endpoints/android_vectors_test.go) and by the app's rule
# field (feature/rules RuleVectorsTest.kt). One line per rule and target,
#   rule        what the user types, without the +/- prefix
#   typed       yes if the app's rule field accepts it, no if it refuses it
#   blockScope  label the rule list shows for "- rule" (empty if not typed)
#   allowScope  label the rule list shows for "+ rule" (empty if not typed)
#   target      a domain or an IP address to match, optionally followed by
#               domain points to) and "lists=ID,ID" (filter lists the target
#   block       engine result for "- rule": Denied or NoMatch
#   allow       engine result for "+ rule": Permitted or NoMatch
